name: White Bread
time: ~3 hr 30 min, ~45 min hands-on (mostly rising; estimated)
equipment: Mixer with dough hook, greased bread pans
notes: Ginger taught me that this bread could be put together before school in the midst of morning chaos—“It just has five ingredients!” (and water). Can be used for cinnamon bread, inside-out-pizza, etc.

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.body: Combine in mixer with dough hook: **10 cups bread flour**, **3 Tbsp yeast**, **½ cup sugar** and **2½ Tbsp salt**.

steps.title: Add the wet ingredients
steps.body: Add and mix: **6 cups warm water** and **½ cup oil**.

steps.title: Add more flour
steps.body: Scrape down the sides of the bowl and lid. Then while mixing, add **6-8 cups more bread flour** so the dough doesn’t stick to the sides of the bowl when the mixer is running. Mix for about 5 minutes more.

steps.title: Shape the loaves
steps.body: Mix again for about 5 minutes, then form into 4 loaves and place in greased bread pans.

steps.title: Second rise
steps.body: Let rise til about 1-inch above pan tops.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Remove from pans immediately, butter tops of loaves, and cool before bagging.
